content: Overdose: This medication can be harmful if ingested. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, while Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from heat. This product is flammable, so keep it away from fire and avoid open flames after application until the medication has completely dried. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer. This information was last revised in May 2024.
